messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to methylphenidate: hives; difficulty breathing; swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Call your doctor at once if you have:
- signs of heart problems - chest pain, trouble breathing, feeling like you might pass out;
- signs of psychosis - hallucinations (seeing or hearing things that are not real), new behavior problems, aggression, hostility, paranoia;
- signs of circulation problems - numbness, pain, cold feeling, unexplained wounds, or skin color changes (pale, red, or blue appearance) in your fingers or toes; or
- penis erection that is painful or lasts 4 hours or longer.
- signs of skin problems from the patch - swelling or blisters at the application site, or loss of skin color;
Seek medical attention right away if you have symptoms of serotonin syndrome, such as: agitation, hallucinations, fever, sweating, shivering, fast heart rate, muscle stiffness, twitching, loss of coordination, nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.
Triplet: ["methylphenidate", "has serious side effect symptom", "fast heart rate"]

The relation 'has serious side effect symptom' in the triplet is defined as 'An overdose or adverse reaction to the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has overdose risk': An overdose of the subject drug may result in the serious or life-threatening consequence specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
F. None of the above.
